display_title: I Already Said Two Was Too Much
description:
Bomi is a popular social butterfly at school, known as a go-to advisor for dating and even nicknamed a “couple matching manager.” Ironically, she has never been in a relationship herself. She has long harbored a crush on her childhood friend’s older brother, Juheon, but he only sees her as a little sister. Meanwhile, her childhood friend Sihu constantly interferes with any guy who approaches her, claiming no one understands her better than he does. As tensions build, Bomi finally reaches her breaking point—and both brothers begin to reveal their hidden desires, turning their complicated relationship into something far more intense and unpredictable.
